items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: He was the leader. ... Na-Na Moret. He was a trumpet player.

ctx.x: Before we get away from the Excelsior, who was in that band? We ought to get that.
Well, I'm telling you the fact that it would be hard for me to remember all those fellas. He was the leader. Who was the leader? Uh-huh. Na-Na Moret. He was a trumpet player.
